$Comment: Skullbreaker, the Blunt Focus's signature: a charged mace swing (a Charged hit that counts for Blunt, on the Physical damage line) staggers its foe for 1 second (CommonLib's Zig_Staggered, a Stun to a boss's rules, so a boss or an elite shrugs it). It has no wait of its own: the charged swing sets its pace, and the foe's Immunity stops a lock, since each stagger that lands ramps it, so a foe staggered again soon is held shorter each time (full, three quarters, half, a quarter) and then shrugs staggers for a while; an Immune foe is passed over. A hit counts for Blunt while what you hold trains Blunt or when the hit earns Blunt XP (the Holder's MmoWeaponSkill, read on that hit). Opens on the Signature step while the Blunt Focus is sworn. Retune or switch it off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/procs.json.
